rounds.text: Syncom Formulations (India) Ltd is significantly undervalued by the market, trading at a P/E of 16.5x [E1] and an EV/EBITDA of 11.37x against sector benchmarks of 20.77x and 16.25x respectively [E6, E11]. The underlying financial health is exceptionally strong, backed by a pristine balance sheet featuring a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x and borrowings reduced to just Rs 1 Cr [E38, E39]. Profitability metrics drastically outperform the sector, with an ROCE of 24.46% and ROE of 18.42% compared to sector benchmarks of 6.42% and -3% [E10, E9]. Furthermore, intrinsic value derived from a discounted cash flow model sits at Rs 33 per share against a market price of Rs 13.3, offering a substantial margin of safety of 59.7% [E44, E45]. Compounded profit growth has been robust, delivering 21% CAGR over 5 years and accelerating to 56% over 3 years [E19, E20]. Conceded: [E61], though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out a dividend, and working capital days have increased from 103 days to 164 days [E63].
